Class Cabin

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.shipBuilding.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.shipBuilding.Cabin
All Implemented Interfaces:
ComponentInterface
public non-sealed class Cabin extends Component implements ComponentInterface
Represents a cabin component in the ship, which can house crew members of a specific type.
